snippet.title: The Untouchable (Windows game 2000)
snippet.description:
The Untouchable is a fighting (battle) action game by Global Star Software, Creative Edge Studios.
You can select one of eight fighters.

By the way, the sound effects are muted absolutely.
I don't know the reason. 😥

#battlegames #fightgame #fightgaming #fightgames #fightgameplay
